end.summary:
Discussed why family members share household work.
Trisha named putting away toys and placing plates as tasks children can do.
Trisha said sharing work prevents one person from becoming too tired.
Discussed that families can differ in size and members.
The idea that only grown-ups care for the family remained unresolved.
end.parentNote: Asha practised family care through everyday examples and questions. Trisha named putting away toys and placing plates, and explained that everyone can share work so one person does not get too tired. The mix-up that children are too small to help was not fully corrected by the end. At home, invite Trisha to choose one small household task and talk about how it helps the family.
